shortDescription.default: SZL Holdings enterprise dashboard web parts for SharePoint

longDescription.default: A suite of SZL Holdings enterprise web parts that embed Lyte Command Center signals, Vessels fleet status, Terra market intelligence, and Alloy workflow execution status directly in SharePoint sites. Authenticates via Azure AD and fetches live data from the SZL API.
